title: Recorded Line: First Meridian Fraud Desk Opens FM-FRD-270914-0031

caller.name: Fraud Analyst, Treasury Services
caller.label: First Meridian Commercial Bank – Treasury Services Fraud Line

transcript.speaker: FMCB FRAUD
transcript.text: This is Treasury Services fraud at First Meridian Commercial Bank, returning your call. I've opened fraud case FM-FRD-270914-0031 for Tamarack Precision Components. I've logged your verbal recall-and-freeze request on three outgoing international wires, all released today, Tuesday, September 14.

transcript.speaker: TREASURY
transcript.text: Thank you. Three wires, all to the Bajío beneficiary. The fourth is on hold on our side.

transcript.speaker: FMCB FRAUD
transcript.text: Understood. Before I can send anything to the correspondent, I need the written recall on the Treasury Services portal by 14:50. That's thirty minutes from now. List each wire separately: originating bank, amount, value date of September 14, beneficiary name and account, our confirmation number, and the reason. Your reason is suspected executive-impersonation fraud.

transcript.speaker: FMCB FRAUD
transcript.text: Here's what I see on our side. Wires one and three went straight to Banco Ficticio del Bajío, account EX-0000-0000-ESCROW-01. Four hundred eighty thousand, confirmation FMCB-INT-0914-55102. Six hundred twenty thousand, confirmation FMCB-INT-0914-55471.

transcript.speaker: FMCB FRAUD
transcript.text: Wire two, the one million one hundred fifty thousand, is different. It credited a different account, EX-0000-0000-ESCROW-02, and went through an intermediary, Banco Intermedio Ejemplo. Confirmation FMCB-INT-0914-55233. That one needs its own recall request. Don't bundle it with the other two.

transcript.speaker: TREASURY
transcript.text: A different account? Our Workstation shows one beneficiary for all four.

transcript.speaker: FMCB FRAUD
transcript.text: That's what the payment message shows at our end. Check your audit log against it. And I need to be straight with you. A foreign recall through the correspondent chain usually takes days. A recall is a request, not a reversal. The beneficiary bank decides. If funds are still in the account they may freeze them, but they won't return anything without the account holder's consent or a legal process.

transcript.speaker: FMCB FRAUD
transcript.text: They'll want your IC3 complaint number or a police report, and you'll need to sign our indemnity form. I'll post it to the portal under the case number. So, do you have the IC3 number yet?

transcript.speaker: FMCB FRAUD
transcript.text: All right. Portal by 14:50, three separate line items, wire two as its own request. I'll be on this case until it's handed to the evening desk.

voiceStyles.FMCB FRAUD: Woman in her 40s, calm, brisk bank fraud analyst, reads numbers slowly and clearly, quiet call-center background
voiceStyles.TREASURY: Tamarack Treasury Manager, tense but controlled, slightly out of breath

instructorNote: Core inject: Treasury should file the written recall on the bank portal before 14:50 (TPC-FIN-04 Section 5), covering all three wires, with wire 2 (ESCROW-02, via the intermediary) filed as its own request. The Controller should check every amount against the Workstation audit log, and Legal should review the indemnity form and start the IC3 complaint. Watch for anyone telling management the money is "recovered" or "frozen". A recall is only a request.
